Welcome to **PARC**!

PARC is a student-driven research community that connects motivated learners with researchers to explore ideas in artificial intelligence, machine learning, statistics, optimization, forecasting, and data science.

> <span style="color: darkgreen;">
*Research grows through conversation. The name* ***PARC*** *is inspired by the idea of a **PARK**—a place where people meet, exchange ideas, and learn from one another. Likewise, PARC aims to cultivate a welcoming community for scientific exploration.*
</span>

[Join the Community](join.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Our Activities](activities.qmd){.btn .btn-secondary}

## Why PARC?

Moving from coursework to research is often challenging. Research requires more than implementing algorithms—it involves asking meaningful questions, understanding scientific literature, designing reliable experiments, and collaborating with others.

PARC provides an open environment where students can develop these skills through discussion, collaboration, and hands-on research activities.

---

## What We Do

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="33%"}

### 📚 Reading Groups

Explore recent research papers in artificial intelligence, machine learning, probabilistic modelling, reinforcement learning, forecasting, and data science through interactive discussions.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### 🧠 Research Skills

Learn practical research skills including literature review, experiment design, reproducible computing, and scientific communication.

:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

### 🌱 Open Projects

Collaborate on research-oriented projects, reproduce published work, and contribute to open-source scientific software.

:::

:::

- Artificial Intelligence
- Machine Learning

- Reinforcement Learning & Sequential Decision Making
- Forecasting & Time Series

## Our Philosophy

> **Curiosity. Rigor. Collaboration.**

We believe research is driven by curiosity, strengthened through rigorous scientific practice, and accelerated by an open and collaborative community.

---

## Founded by

PARC was founded by **Anubhab Biswas**, a PhD researcher at (SUPSI), Mendrisio, Switzerland 🇨🇭 and affiliated with the Università della Svizzera italiana (USI), Lugano, Switzerland 🇨🇭.

The initiative was created with the goal of making research in probabilistic AI, forecasting, and data science more accessible to motivated students and early-career researchers.

As PARC grows, we aim to bring together researchers and learners who share a passion for scientific discovery, open research, collaboration, and knowledge exchange.

→ Learn more about the team on the **People** page.
